scenicChapters.title: Trieste → Longobards in Italy. Places of the Power
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 75 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

city-trieste-longday.story: A 386 km round trip from Trieste - roughly 6 h 39 in the saddle. The stops in between: Longobards in Italy. Places of the Power, The Gastaldaga area and the Episcopal comp, Kolišča na Igu and Količa na Igu. The highest point is about 800 m. It crosses from Italy into Slovenia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
